repeated_clauses.en: Install 1 resource from your grip, paying 3[credit] less.

translations.zh: 从你的操控器安装1个资源，其安装费用减3[credit]。

repeated_clauses.en: Install only faceup. (This agenda is neither rezzed nor unrezzed.) Whenever you advance this agenda, gain 2[credit]. If there are 5 or more hosted advancement counters (including the counter just placed), gain 3[credit] instead.

translations.zh: 本议案仅能面朝上安装。（本议案不视为已激活或未激活。） 每当你推进本议案时，获得2[credit]。如果所附载的推进指示物有5枚或更多（包括刚放上去的那1枚），则改为获得3[credit]。

repeated_clauses.en: Install up to 2 cards from HQ (one at a time).

translations.zh: 从总部安装最多2张卡牌（每次一张）。

repeated_clauses.en: Interface -> [trash] or hosted power counter: Break 1 sentry subroutine.

translations.zh: 对接 -> [trash]或所附载的能量指示物：破解1条警报子进程。

repeated_clauses.en: Move up to 2 advancement counters from 1 other card to the chosen card.

translations.zh: 从另1张卡牌上转移最多2枚推进指示物到所选择的卡牌上。

repeated_clauses.en: Once per turn -> 0[credit]: Break 1 barrier subroutine.

translations.zh: 0[credit]：破解1条屏障子进程。本能力每回合仅限使用一次。

repeated_clauses.en: Once per turn -> 2 hosted advancement counters: Place 2 advancement counters on another card you can advance in the root of this server.

translations.zh: 每回合限一次 -> 2枚所附载的推进指示物：放置2枚推进指示物到本服务器根目录中另一张你可以推进的卡牌上。

repeated_clauses.en: Once per turn -> [click]: Gain 2[credit].

translations.zh: 每回合限一次 -> [click]：获得2[credit]。

repeated_clauses.en: Place 4[credit] on this event.

translations.zh: 放置4[credit]到本事件上。

repeated_clauses.en: Place X advancement counters on 1 installed card you can advance.

translations.zh: 放置X枚推进指示物到1张你可以推进的已安装的卡牌上。

repeated_clauses.en: Play only if the Runner made a successful run during their last turn.

translations.zh: 只有潜袭者在其上回合进行过成功的潜袭时，才能打出。

repeated_clauses.en: Play only if the Runner stole an agenda during their last turn.

translations.zh: 只有潜袭者在其上回合窃取过议案时，才能打出。

repeated_clauses.en: Play only if you are not tagged.

translations.zh: 只有你未被锁定时，才能打出。

repeated_clauses.en: Play only if you made a successful run on HQ this turn.

translations.zh: 只有你本回合已对总部进行过成功的潜袭时，才能打出。

repeated_clauses.en: Reveal up to 5 cards in HQ.

translations.zh: 展示总部中的最多5张卡牌。

repeated_clauses.en: Run a server protected by ice.

translations.zh: 潜袭一台有防火墙保护的服务器。

repeated_clauses.en: Runs against this server cannot be declared successful. (This effect does not cause runs to become unsuccessful.) Limit 1 region per server.

translations.zh: 对本服务器的潜袭不能宣告为成功。（本效果不会导致潜袭被视为失败。） 每台服务器限制1个区域。

repeated_clauses.en: Search either your stack or your heap for 1 program. (Shuffle your stack after searching it.) Install that program, ignoring all costs. When your turn ends, if that program has not been uninstalled, add it to the top of your stack.

translations.zh: 在你的存储栈或堆阵搜寻1个程序。（如果搜寻了存储栈则将其洗混。）安装该程序，忽略所有的费用。当你的回合结束时，如果该程序仍未被卸载，将其加入你的存储栈顶端。

repeated_clauses.en: Starter game only.

translations.zh: 仅用于起始包对战。

repeated_clauses.en: The Corp must set aside the top 8 cards of R&D faceup.

translations.zh: 公司必须将研发中心顶端8张卡牌牌面朝上置于一旁。

repeated_clauses.en: The first piece of ice the Corp rezzes each turn costs 1[credit] more to rez.

translations.zh: 每回合公司激活的第一层防火墙的激活费用加1[credit]。

repeated_clauses.en: The first time each turn you encounter a piece of ice, it gains code gate for the remainder of this run.

translations.zh: 每回合你第一次遭遇一层防火墙时，该防火墙在本次潜袭的剩余时间内获得门禁。

repeated_clauses.en: The first time you encounter a piece of ice during that run, bypass it.

translations.zh: 本次潜袭中你第一次遭遇一层防火墙时，略过该防火墙。

repeated_clauses.en: The rez cost of each piece of ice is increased by 1[credit].

translations.zh: 每层防火墙的激活费用加1[credit]。

repeated_clauses.en: The Runner cannot break subroutines on this ice using AI programs.

translations.zh: 潜袭者不能使用智能模块程序破解本防火墙上的子进程。

repeated_clauses.en: The Runner may jack out.

translations.zh: 潜袭者可以退出潜袭。

repeated_clauses.en: The strength of this ice cannot be lowered.

translations.zh: 本防火墙的强度不能被降低。

repeated_clauses.en: Then, the Corp shuffles the set-aside cards into R&D.

translations.zh: 然后，公司将置于一旁的卡牌洗入研发中心。

repeated_clauses.en: Then, you may pay 1[credit] to add this event to your grip.

translations.zh: 然后你可以支付1[credit]，以将本事件加入你的操控器。

repeated_clauses.en: This agenda is worth 1 more agenda point for each hosted agenda counter.

translations.zh: 每有1枚所附载的议案指示物，本议案的价值增加1点议案分数。

repeated_clauses.en: This program gets +1 strength for each hosted power counter, and it can only interface with ice of exactly equal strength.

translations.zh: 每有1枚所附载的能量指示物，本程序的强度+1，且本程序只能与强度与其相等的防火墙对接。

repeated_clauses.en: Trace[5].

translations.zh: 追踪 5。

repeated_clauses.en: Trash this ice.

translations.zh: 销毁本防火墙。

repeated_clauses.en: Use this ability only during a run against another server.

translations.zh: 本能力仅能在对另一台服务器的潜袭中使用。

repeated_clauses.en: Use this ability only during a run on this server.

translations.zh: 本能力仅能在对本服务器的潜袭中使用。

repeated_clauses.en: Use this ability only during your turn.

translations.zh: 本能力仅能在你的回合中使用。

repeated_clauses.en: Use this ability only if there are 4 or more hosted advancement counters.

translations.zh: 只有所附载的推进指示物有4枚或更多时，才能使用本能力。

repeated_clauses.en: Use this ability only if this program was installed this turn.

translations.zh: 本能力仅能在安装本程序的回合使用。

repeated_clauses.en: When that run ends, if it was successful, gain 5[credit].

translations.zh: 当本次潜袭结束时，如果潜袭成功，获得5[credit]。

repeated_clauses.en: When that run is successful, trash all cards in the root of the attacked server.

translations.zh: 当本次潜袭成功时，销毁被攻击的服务器根目录中的所有卡牌。

repeated_clauses.en: When the Corp purges virus counters, trash this program.

translations.zh: 当公司清除病毒指示物时，销毁本程序。

repeated_clauses.en: When the Runner accesses this asset anywhere except in Archives, you may pay 4[credit].

translations.zh: 当潜袭者从档案库以外其他区域读取本资产时，你可以支付4[credit]。

repeated_clauses.en: When the Runner encounters this ice, gain 1[credit].

translations.zh: 当潜袭者遭遇本防火墙时，你获得1[credit]。

repeated_clauses.en: When the Runner encounters this ice, they must pay 3[credit], if able.

translations.zh: 当潜袭者遭遇本防火墙时，如可能，其必须支付3[credit]。

repeated_clauses.en: When you draw those cards, add 1 of them to the bottom of R&D.

translations.zh: 当你抽这些卡牌时，将其中1张加入研发中心底端。

repeated_clauses.en: When you install this hardware, load 3 power counters onto it.

translations.zh: 当你安装本硬件时，填装3枚能量指示物到本硬件上。

repeated_clauses.en: When you install this hardware, suffer 1 core damage.

translations.zh: 当你安装本硬件时，受到1点核心伤害。

repeated_clauses.en: When you install this hardware, suffer 1 meat damage.

translations.zh: 当你安装本硬件时，受到1点肢体伤害。

repeated_clauses.en: When you install this program, choose 1 installed piece of ice.

translations.zh: 当你安装本程序时，选择1层已安装的防火墙。

repeated_clauses.en: When you install this program, place 2 power counters on it.

translations.zh: 当你安装本程序时，放置2枚能量指示物到本程序上。

repeated_clauses.en: When you install this program, place 2 virus counters on it. Access, once per turn -> Hosted virus counter: Trash the card you are accessing.

translations.zh: 当你安装本程序时，放置2枚病毒指示物到本程序上。 读取 -> 所附载的病毒指示物：销毁你正在读取的卡牌。本能力每回合仅限使用一次。

repeated_clauses.en: When you install this program, place 6 power counters on it.

translations.zh: 当你安装本程序时，放置6枚能量指示物到本程序上。

repeated_clauses.en: When you install this program, you may spend any number of credits to place that many power counters on it.

translations.zh: 当你安装本程序时，你可以支付X[credit]，以放置X枚能量指示物到本程序上。

repeated_clauses.en: When you install this resource, load 16[credit] onto it.

translations.zh: 当你安装本资源时，填装16[credit]到本资源上。

repeated_clauses.en: When you install this resource, load 3 power counters onto it.

translations.zh: 当你安装本资源时，填装3枚能量指示物到本资源上。

repeated_clauses.en: When you rez this ice during a run against this server, you may derez another installed card.

translations.zh: 在对本服务器的潜袭中，当你激活本防火墙时，你可以关闭另一张已安装的卡牌。

repeated_clauses.en: When you rez this ice during a run against this server, you may have the Runner gain 2[credit].

translations.zh: 在对本服务器的潜袭中，当你激活本防火墙时，你可以令潜袭者获得2[credit]。

repeated_clauses.en: When you rez this ice during a run against this server, you may trash 1 card from HQ to do 2 net damage.

translations.zh: 在对本服务器的潜袭中，当你激活本防火墙时，你可以从总部销毁1张卡牌，以造成2点网域伤害。

repeated_clauses.en: When you score this agenda, do 2 meat damage.

translations.zh: 当你将本议案计分时，造成2点肢体伤害。

repeated_clauses.en: When you score this agenda, gain 7[credit] and take 1 bad publicity.

translations.zh: 当你将本议案计分时，获得7[credit]并拿取1枚负面声誉标记。

repeated_clauses.en: When you score this agenda, if there is another copy of Megaprix Qualifier in either playerʼs score area, place 1 agenda counter on this agenda.

translations.zh: 当你计分本议案时，如果任一玩家的分数区内有另一张名称为极大奖资格赛的卡牌，放置1枚议案指示物到本议案上。

repeated_clauses.en: When you score this agenda, place 1 agenda counter on it for every 2 hosted advancement counters past 3.

translations.zh: 当你将本议案计分时，如果所附载的推进指示物超过3枚，每超过2枚，放置1枚议案指示物到本议案上。

repeated_clauses.en: When you score this agenda, place 3 agenda counters on it.

translations.zh: 当你将本议案计分时，放置3枚议案指示物到本议案上。

repeated_clauses.en: When your turn begins and whenever you steal an agenda, place 1[credit] on this resource.

translations.zh: 当你的回合开始或你窃取一个议案时，放置1[credit]到本资源上。

repeated_clauses.en: When your turn begins, place 1 advancement counter on a card in the root of this server.

translations.zh: 当你的回合开始时，放置1枚推进指示物到本服务器内的1张卡牌上。

repeated_clauses.en: When your turn begins, place 1 advancement counter on a piece of ice protecting this server.

translations.zh: 当你的回合开始时，放置1枚推进指示物到1层保护本服务器的防火墙上。

repeated_clauses.en: When your turn begins, remove 1 hosted power counter and draw 2 cards.

translations.zh: 当你的回合开始时，移除1枚所附载的能量指示物并抽2张卡牌。

repeated_clauses.en: When your turn ends, if there are 3 or more hosted credits, you must trash 1 card from your grip at random or trash this resource.

translations.zh: 当你的回合结束时，如果所附载的信用点有3个或更多，你必须从你的操控器中随机销毁1张卡牌或者销毁本资源。

repeated_clauses.en: Whenever an agenda is scored or stolen, do 1 net damage.

translations.zh: 每当一个议案被计分或窃取时，造成1点网域伤害。

repeated_clauses.en: Whenever the Runner approaches this server, end the run unless they pay 2[credit] for each advanced piece of ice protecting this server.

translations.zh: 每当潜袭者接驳本服务器时，终止本次潜袭，除非潜袭者支付等同于保护本服务器的已推进的防火墙二倍数量的信用点。

repeated_clauses.en: Whenever the Runner makes a successful run on this server, do 1 net damage.

translations.zh: 每当潜袭者对本服务器进行一次成功的潜袭时，造成1点网域伤害。

repeated_clauses.en: Whenever you encounter the chosen ice, you may pay 1[credit] for each subroutine it has.

translations.zh: 每当你遭遇所选择的防火墙时，你可以支付与该防火墙上子进程数量相等的[credit]。

repeated_clauses.en: Whenever you play a transaction operation, gain 1[credit].

translations.zh: 每当你打出一个交易事务时，获得1[credit]。

repeated_clauses.en: While the Runner is accessing this upgrade in R&D, they must reveal it.

translations.zh: 在潜袭者从研发中心读取本升级的期间，其必须展示之。

repeated_clauses.en: While there are no installed fracter programs, this ice gets +7 strength.

translations.zh: 只要没有已安装的分解模块程序，本防火墙的强度便+7。

repeated_clauses.en: While this agenda has a hosted agenda counter, it is worth 1 more agenda point.

translations.zh: 只要本议案上有所附载的议案指示物，其价值便增加1点议案分数。

repeated_clauses.en: While you are encountering a piece of ice, it gets -1 strength.

translations.zh: 在你遭遇一层防火墙的期间，该防火墙的强度-1。

repeated_clauses.en: X is equal to the sum of the printed agenda points on all agendas the Runner stole during their last turn.

translations.zh: X等于潜袭者在其上回合所窃取的所有议案的印刷议案分数总和。

repeated_clauses.en: X must be equal to or less than the number of tags the Runner has.

translations.zh: X必须等于或少于潜袭者所具有的锁定标记数量。

repeated_clauses.en: You can advance this upgrade.

translations.zh: 你可以推进本升级。

repeated_clauses.en: You can spend hosted credits during that run.

translations.zh: 你可以在本次潜袭中花费所附载的信用点。

repeated_clauses.en: You can spend hosted credits to play events.

translations.zh: 你可以花费所附载的信用点以打出事件。

repeated_clauses.en: You may draw 1 card.

translations.zh: 你可以抽1张卡牌。

repeated_clauses.en: You may install 1 card from HQ.

translations.zh: 你可以从总部安装1张卡牌。

repeated_clauses.en: You may spend [click] to access another 1 of those cards.

translations.zh: 你可以花费[click]，以读取其中另1张卡牌。

repeated_clauses.en: Your deck cannot include more than 1 copy of any card.

translations.zh: 你的牌组中每种同名卡牌限1张。
